description: This file contains the implementation of the UserDao interface, specifically dealing with user data retrieval operations such as fetching users by username or ID, and listing users, within a Java project using JPA and QueryDSL.

classes.name: UserDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for UserDao, providing concrete methods to query User entities from the database.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity by username, including related groups, merchant store, and language information.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity by user ID, including related groups, merchant store, and language information.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Lists all users with their related groups, merchant store, and language, ordered by user ID.

methods.name: listUserByStore
methods.description: Lists users associated with a specific merchant store, including related groups and language, ordered by user ID.
